text: The authors hire two groups of five participants through Surge AI, one group per task, collect answers on 100 randomly sampled validation questions per experiment, and report data from only four participants per task because one participant per task was far more accurate unassisted (84% vs 57% on MMLU, 89% vs 49% on QuALITY) and beat the best model result, which they say would likely violate the sandwiching assumption that participants lack knowledge the model can provide.
title: Experiment setup: Surge AI participants, 100 questions per condition, outlier exclusion
